title: Is Tinyhouse Chess Solvable?
summary: The creator plays Tinyhouse on chess.com against human opponents (e.g. RealMrHater, zacharyisw..., ~1437-1500) and asks whether this tiny 4x4 crazyhouse-style variant is solvable (thumbnail: '3.5 x 10^13 Positions', 'Solved?' loading bar). Captured pieces go to your pocket and can be dropped back onto the board.
rules: Each side starts with a king, one minor piece (bishop or knight) and pawns (frames show White K,B,P,P vs Black K,N,P,P).
Crazyhouse drops: a captured enemy piece changes colour and goes to your pocket; on your turn you may drop a pocket piece on any empty square instead of moving (pocket shown at left of board).
Pawns promote on the far (4th) rank (inferred, standard crazyhouse convention).
Otherwise normal chess movement, check and checkmate.
